title: Never enable Cloudflare Web Analytics from the Pages dashboard; the beacon is wired by hand in Analytics.astro
body:
Enabling Web Analytics in the Pages dashboard injects the beacon into the WHOLE site on the next deploy, /cv and /en/cv included. Those pages must stay at zero JS because Browser Rendering prints the published page for the PDF (waits on networkidle), so a script there silently changes production PDFs. no-client-js.check.ts cannot see it: it reads dist/, and the injection happens at the edge. Only scripts/served.check.ts (smoke-deploy.yml) would catch it, after the fact.
Instead the beacon (PUBLIC_CF_BEACON_TOKEN, an external src) lives in src/components/Analytics.astro, used by the reader pages only (src/pages/index.astro, en/index.astro, brief.astro, en/brief.astro). Clarity (PUBLIC_CLARITY_ID) starts from each page's own script (startAnalytics() in Landing.astro and HomeDocument.astro), not from a <script> in Analytics.astro: Astro would inline that tiny script and the CSP would block it (memory frontend/csp-inline). Never in src/layouts/Base.astro, which /cv uses. A new tag needs its origins in the CSP in public/_headers.
not_derivable: The dashboard toggle is outside the repo; the code shows the manual wiring, not why the toggle must stay off.
